Postharvest drying risk is ELEVATED. Coordinate with DA mechanization service providers for mobile dryer access.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Rain risk for harvest in Mahatao. Defer harvest, use mechanical dryer if available. Call MAO for help.
texts.lgu:
HARVEST ADVISORY — Mahatao
Rainfall of 61.4 mm may disrupt ongoing harvest operations.
Recommended actions:
1. Advise farmers to assess field conditions before deploying machinery.
2. Coordinate with RCEF mechanization pool for mobile dryer deployment.
3. Issue tarpaulin assistance where needed.
4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.
texts.facebook:

Rain is affecting harvest conditions. Delay harvesting if fields are wet. Use mechanical dryers to prevent grain spoilage.

📞 Contact your Municipal Agriculturist for drying support.

texts.bulletin: FERTILIZER APPLICATION ADVISORY — Mahatao: Current rainfall conditions increase risk of nutrient loss through leaching and runoff. DEFER basal and top-dress fertilizer application until 2–3 dry days are observed. Consider split-application strategy when conditions improve. For critical growth stages, consult AEW/MAO before proceeding.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Do not apply fertilizer today due to rain risk. Wait 2-3 dry days. Less waste, better yield.
texts.lgu:
AGRI-OPERATIONS ADVISORY — Mahatao
Advise farmers to postpone fertilizer application. Rain will reduce fertilizer efficacy and increase runoff to waterways.
texts.facebook:
🌱 FERTILIZER REMINDER — Mahatao:
Hindi magandang maglagay ng pataba ngayon dahil may ulan. Maghintay ng 2–3 araw na tuyo para mas epektibo ang pataba. #PatubaAdvice #DARFOCagayanValley

texts.bulletin: SPRAYING ADVISORY — Mahatao: Do not apply pesticides or foliar fertilizers in rainy conditions. Rain within 4–6 hours of application will wash off chemicals, reducing efficacy and increasing environmental contamination risk. Reschedule spraying to early morning hours on clear days.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Do not spray pesticides when raining. Reschedule to clear morning. Saves money, protects water.
texts.lgu: SPRAYING ADVISORY — Mahatao: Rainfall expected. Advise farmers to defer all pesticide and foliar spraying.
